name: Leptostomia
isnote: Described as ?Azhdarchoidea; known material too limited for a confident family assignment.
sum: Small azhdarchoid from the Kem Kem Group of Morocco with an extraordinarily thin, long beak.
wsnote: Skull length estimated 6–20 cm — much smaller than most contemporaries.
holotype: FSAC-KK 5075 — Kem Kem Group, near Hassi El Begaa, Morocco.
material: Two isolated beak fragments (upper beak and lower beak).
biology: Slender, slightly upcurved toothless beak with many sensory foramina, suggesting a probe-feeder that searched sediment for invertebrates, like curlews, woodcocks and kiwis (Smith et al. 2020).
author: Smith et al. 2020
